- Survive!

Locations.Title: Fortuna
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Previous:** [Easy Riders](https://mapgenie.io/kingdom-come-deliverance-2/maps/trosky?locationIds=425693)  

**Next:** [Laboratores](https://mapgenie.io/kingdom-come-deliverance-2/maps/trosky?locationIds=425709)

**Quest Steps:**
- Stop the bleeding.
- Splash water on yourself at the tub.
- Eat.
- Show yourself to [Bozhena](https://mapgenie.io/kingdom-come-deliverance-2/maps/trosky?locationIds=426071).
- Pick chamomile.
- Pick sage.
   - Take the spade. (Optional)
   - Pick up the corpse. (Optional)
   - Carry the corpse to the stream. (Optional)
   - Dig a grave. (Optional)
   - Cover the corpse with earth. (Optional.
- Fetch herbs for Bozhena.
- Find out what's happening at Bozhena's.
   - Get hold of a weapon! (Optional)
   - Arm yourself! (Optional)
   - Repel the men who've come!
- Brew a healing potion.
   - Look in the book.
   - Read the recipe and return to the bench.
   - Pour the correct base into the cauldron.
   - Move the cauldron down.
   - Let the cauldron boil.
   - Move the cauldron up.
   - Open your inventory.
   - Prepare the herbs.
   - Toss in two handfuls of chamomile.
   - Turn the sandglass over.
   - Brew the chamomile for one turn of the sandglass.
   - Move the cauldron up.
   - Grind a handful of sage.
   - Toss the ground sage into the cauldron.
   - Pour out the remedy.
- Sleep until morning.
- Join the others for breakfast.
- Talk to Capon about leaving for Trosky.

Locations.Title: For Whom the Bells Tolls
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**Previous:** [Wedding Crashers](https://mapgenie.io/kingdom-come-deliverance-2/maps/trosky?locationIds=425630)  

**Next:** [Back in the Saddle](https://mapgenie.io/kingdom-come-deliverance-2/maps/trosky?locationIds=426649)

**Quest Steps:**
- Save Sir Hans from execution.
   - Get to Thomas.
   - Haul the sacks to the charcoal shed. (Optional)
      - Talk to the blacksmith.
      - Take care of the horseshoe for the blacksmith. (Optional)
      - Unlock Fanka's spice chest. (Optional)
      - Take the horseshoe to Kabat.
      - Find Kabat's rosary. (Optional)
   - Find work around the gallows. (Optional)
      - Help Kolda with his axe. (Optional)
      - Bring Kolda the sharpened axe. (Optional)
   - Find out what medicine to give Captain Thomas.
   - Get hold of fever tonic.
      - Take the medicine back to Thomas.

**Progression Hint:** There are many ways to do this quest, but at minimum, you'll need to get [lockpicks](https://mapgenie.io/kingdom-come-deliverance-2/maps/trosky?locationIds=428566) or keys to open chests later.  [Hired Hand Kabat](https://mapgenie.io/kingdom-come-deliverance-2/maps/trosky?locationIds=428434) also has lockpicks if you do his tasks first.  Sneak into the chapel tower and talk to Thomas.  Sneak into the southern tower, pick up the [Physician's Journal](https://mapgenie.io/kingdom-come-deliverance-2/maps/trosky?locationIds=428459) and the necessary ingredients from the [Chest (easy)](https://mapgenie.io/kingdom-come-deliverance-2/maps/trosky?locationIds=428460) - then brew the Fever Tonic at the [Alchemy Bench](https://mapgenie.io/kingdom-come-deliverance-2/maps/trosky?locationIds=426646) in the same room.  Alternatively, if you have the lockpick skill, you can simply rob the [Chest (hard)](https://mapgenie.io/kingdom-come-deliverance-2/maps/trosky?locationIds=428462) for the Fever Tonic.  Finally, sneak back to Thomas.

Locations.Title: Demons of Trosky
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Begin:** Speak to Chamberlain Ulrick after progressing through the main quest [Back in the Saddle](https://mapgenie.io/kingdom-come-deliverance-2/maps/trosky?locationIds=426649)  

**Note:** This task must be completed before speaking with Capon during the main quest [For Victory!](https://mapgenie.io/kingdom-come-deliverance-2/maps/trosky?locationIds=426671)

**Reward:**
- 55 Groschen
- Golden cup
- Golden chalice

**Quest Steps:**
- Talk to Manyeta.
   - Banish the devils from the Crone's side of the castle.
- Talk to Bertha.
   - Banish the devils from the Maiden's side of the castle.
- Talk to Osina.
   - Find the devils according to the blacksmith's directions.
   - Return to Osina.
   - Find the devils according to the blacksmith's directions.
   - Return to Osina.
   - Find the devils according to the blacksmith's directions.
   - Return to Osina.
- Return to the chamberlain.

Locations.Title: Bird of Prey
Locations.DescriptionMarkdown:
**How to Begin:** Speak with [Gamekeeper Vostatek](https://mapgenie.io/kingdom-come-deliverance-2/maps/trosky?locationIds=426173) at least one day after completing side quest [Lackey](https://mapgenie.io/kingdom-come-deliverance-2/maps/trosky?locationIds=425840)  

**Reward(s):**
- Groschen x175

**Quest Steps:**
- Deal with the poacher in the forest near Rocktower Pond
- Tell Vostatek about the poacher from Rocktower Pond
- Deal with the poacher in the forest near Vidlak Pond
  - Talk to the tanner about the poacher 
  - Talk to the fisherman's wife about the poachers
- Tell Vostatek about the poacher from Vidlak Pond 
- Ask Varel the gamekeeper about work 
  - Ask the gravedigger about poachers
- Find the truth about the poacher in the Slatego forests 
- Tell Varel about the poacher from Slatego 
- Find the poacher in the Lower Semine forests
  - Ask around in The Lair about poachers 
- Find evidence of poaching in the camp
  - Wipe out the poaching bandits 
- Report the Lower Semine camp to the Gamekeeper
